contract.booleanTiePolicy: even-odd profile winding; horizontal bands use lower-inclusive upper-exclusive crossings; equal-x crossings preserve source edge order
contract.inputContract: Zero, one, or two contained through-holes are permitted. Distinct hole circles must have center distance strictly greater than the sum of their radii; overlapping or tangent tools are rejected before feature construction in both targets.
contract.floatingPointPolicy: IEEE-754 f64 scalar source order; no fast-math, contraction, SIMD, threads, exceptions or tail calls
contract.allocationPolicy: Counts output backing stores created by the invoked target path. JavaScript allocates its output Uint8Array; the Wasm wrapper allocates the returned output copy. Metadata used by untimed validation is excluded.
contract.counterPolicy: Feature, solid, cut, fillet, and boolean-intersection counters increment at their operative construction sites. Scan intersection, sort, triangle, and tessellation-vertex counters increment from traversing and emitting the final B-rep mesh. Boundary crossings increment around the actual Wasm run call.

targets.semanticWork: Authored JavaScript constructs complete box and cylinder B-reps, splices each material cylinder wall/rims into the cut solid, applies four Euler fillet edits, validates vertices/edges/coedges/loops/faces and Euler genus, then tessellates by traversing the final B-rep face loops.

Authored C compiled to fixed-memory linear Wasm independently constructs complete box and cylinder B-reps, performs material cut and Euler fillet edits, validates coedge/loop/face adjacency and Euler genus, then tessellates by traversing the final B-rep. JavaScript copies the 128-byte feature-tree fixture and validates the returned output with an independent mesh Euler oracle.
